details:
Here are some current bugs I have found for Quest/PC ONLY/IOS users such as myself and others, firstly I have noticed by the people I have talked to about an audio crash system. I or another person would be in an instance chilling out then we would get hit with a lag spike, then our audio would disappear, we have cleared our cache data, **all of it even** and have deleted and re-installed VRCHAT to see if that would fix it but it has not. The user can exit out of vrchat and restart it, it would the restore the audio but then a few moments later, it will crash again. 

Next bug I have noticed is that there’s an issue with the loading screen where it would be normal for a second or so then start moving as you are moving your head, this would happen in world hopping etc! Loading into a world and it processing then the backround would move with the users head movement, the loading screen would stay same. 

The last bug im noticing is a lot of users reporting that there is an increasing admout of lag spikes no matter the worlds optimization, the user can be running on good internet and wouldn’t have any issues till now! Please do reach out to me if there’s any way to fix any of these bugs!
title: BUG issues as of 11/04/26
